<requirement name="cli-initialize-store" stories="cli-foundation,ingest_001">
check A1 0 init < /dev/null
</requirement>
<requirement name="load-ecb-history" stories="database,ingest_002">
check A2 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
22,176
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="idempotent-history-load" stories="ingest_002">
check A3 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
22,176
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="reject-invalid-history" stories="ingest_003">
check A4 3 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv" < /dev/null
</requirement>
<requirement name="reject-missing-history-file" stories="ingest_002">
check A5 1 load "$WORK/no-such-file.csv" < /dev/null
</requirement>
<requirement name="cli-usage-errors" stories="cli-foundation,cli_001">
check U1 2 < /dev/null
check U2 2 frobnicate < /dev/null
check U3 2 load < /dev/null
check U4 2 serve --port notaport < /dev/null
</requirement>
<requirement name="serve-on-localhost-port" stories="cli_002">
start_server
</requirement>
<requirement name="health-response" stories="app-server-foundation,api_001">
http H1 200 '/health' <<'EOF'
{"status":"ok"}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="rate-store-statistics" stories="database,api_001">
http H2 200 '/stats' <<'EOF'
{"dates":22,"rates":176,"first":"2025-01-02","last":"2025-01-31"}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="list-available-currencies" stories="api_002">
http H3 200 '/currencies' <<'EOF'
{"base":"EUR","currencies":["AUD","CAD","CHF","CNY","GBP","JPY","SEK","USD"]}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="resolve-rates-by-date" stories="api_003">
http H4 200 '/rates/2025-01-17' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-01-17","requested":"2025-01-17","base":"EUR","rates":{"AUD":"1.6646","CAD":"1.4864","CHF":"0.9394","CNY":"7.5474","GBP":"0.84453","JPY":"160.23","SEK":"11.506","USD":"1.0298"}}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="resolve-rates-on-non-publication-day" stories="api_003">
http H5 200 '/rates/2025-01-18' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-01-17","requested":"2025-01-18","base":"EUR","rates":{"AUD":"1.6646","CAD":"1.4864","CHF":"0.9394","CNY":"7.5474","GBP":"0.84453","JPY":"160.23","SEK":"11.506","USD":"1.0298"}}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="rate-date-error-responses" stories="api_003,api_006">
http H6 404 '/rates/2024-12-31' < /dev/null
http H7 422 '/rates/2025-13-01' < /dev/null
</requirement>
<requirement name="resolve-latest-rates" stories="api_003">
http H8 200 '/rates/latest' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-01-31","requested":"latest","base":"EUR","rates":{"AUD":"1.6702","CAD":"1.5035","CHF":"0.9449","CNY":"7.5363","GBP":"0.83608","JPY":"160.99","SEK":"11.474","USD":"1.0393"}}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="convert-between-currencies" stories="api_004">
http H9 200 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=100&date=2025-01-17' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-01-17","from":"USD","to":"GBP","amount":"100","rate":"0.820091","result":"82.01"}
EOF
http H10 200 '/convert?from=EUR&to=JPY&amount=250.25&date=2025-01-05' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-01-03","from":"EUR","to":"JPY","amount":"250.25","rate":"161.770000","result":"40482.94"}
EOF
http H11 200 '/convert?from=GBP&to=EUR&amount=1000' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-01-31","from":"GBP","to":"EUR","amount":"1000","rate":"1.196058","result":"1196.06"}
EOF
http H12 200 '/convert?from=SEK&to=CNY&amount=12345.67&date=2025-01-20' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-01-20","from":"SEK","to":"CNY","amount":"12345.67","rate":"0.656236","result":"8101.67"}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="convert-validation-errors" stories="api_004,api_006">
http H13 404 '/convert?from=USD&to=XXX&amount=1' < /dev/null
http H14 422 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP' < /dev/null
http H15 422 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=abc' < /dev/null
http H16 404 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=10&date=2024-12-01' < /dev/null
</requirement>
<requirement name="currency-history-and-summary" stories="api_005">
http H17 200 '/history/USD?start=2025-01-20&end=2025-01-24' <<'EOF'
{"currency":"USD","base":"EUR","count":5,"min":"1.0316","max":"1.0472","mean":"1.039840","points":[{"date":"2025-01-20","rate":"1.0316"},{"date":"2025-01-21","rate":"1.0357"},{"date":"2025-01-22","rate":"1.0443"},{"date":"2025-01-23","rate":"1.0404"},{"date":"2025-01-24","rate":"1.0472"}]}
EOF
http H18 200 '/history/CHF?start=2025-01-27' <<'EOF'
{"currency":"CHF","base":"EUR","count":5,"min":"0.943","max":"0.9453","mean":"0.944280","points":[{"date":"2025-01-27","rate":"0.9453"},{"date":"2025-01-28","rate":"0.9441"},{"date":"2025-01-29","rate":"0.943"},{"date":"2025-01-30","rate":"0.9441"},{"date":"2025-01-31","rate":"0.9449"}]}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="history-empty-range-response" stories="api_005">
http H20 200 '/history/USD?start=2025-02-01' <<'EOF'
{"currency":"USD","base":"EUR","count":0,"min":null,"max":null,"mean":null,"points":[]}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="history-validation-errors" stories="api_005,api_006">
http H19 404 '/history/HRK' < /dev/null
http H21 422 '/history/GBP?start=2025-01-31-x' < /dev/null
</requirement>
<requirement name="load-while-server-runs" stories="ingest_002,cli_002">
check L1 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
2,16
EOF
http L2 200 '/stats' <<'EOF'
{"dates":24,"rates":192,"first":"2025-01-02","last":"2025-02-04"}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="latest-rates-after-loading" stories="api_003,ingest_002">
http L3 200 '/rates/latest' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-02-04","requested":"latest","base":"EUR","rates":{"AUD":"1.6629","CAD":"1.4894","CHF":"0.9396","CNY":"7.4943","GBP":"0.83188","JPY":"160.52","SEK":"11.418","USD":"1.0335"}}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="rates-fallback-after-loading" stories="api_003,ingest_002">
http L4 200 '/rates/2025-02-01' <<'EOF'
{"date":"2025-01-31","requested":"2025-02-01","base":"EUR","rates":{"AUD":"1.6702","CAD":"1.5035","CHF":"0.9449","CNY":"7.5363","GBP":"0.83608","JPY":"160.99","SEK":"11.474","USD":"1.0393"}}
EOF
</requirement>
<requirement name="history-after-loading" stories="api_005,ingest_002">
http L5 200 '/history/AUD?start=2025-01-30' <<'EOF'
{"currency":"AUD","base":"EUR","count":4,"min":"1.6629","max":"1.6705","mean":"1.667675","points":[{"date":"2025-01-30","rate":"1.6705"},{"date":"2025-01-31","rate":"1.6702"},{"date":"2025-02-03","rate":"1.6671"},{"date":"2025-02-04","rate":"1.6629"}]}
EOF
</requirement>
<unattached story="architecture"/>
<unattached story="ingest_004"/>
<unattached story="verify_001"/>
